acceptance.A1: the alternative-SGS run lands on the same side of the DNS-RMS threshold as the corrected WALE baseline - by point estimate, by 95% phase-block interval classification, and by the conclusion of the exact one-sided block test at alpha=0.05 (Holm over the two wall models per SGS and grid). Outcome-neutral: M4 asks whether the SGS model CHANGES the verdict, not which verdict it is
acceptance.A2: 0.75 <= E_tau(sgs)/E_tau(WALE) <= 1.33 and |E_tau(sgs)-E_tau(WALE)| < 0.5 |E_tau(WALE)-1| for the same model and grid, so the SGS choice cannot be what decides the classification
acceptance.completeness: at least two alternative SGS closures x two wall models x grids G1c and G2c
acceptance.reported_not_gating: TBLE-vs-equilibrium ranking under each SGS; reattachment, reversed-shear coverage, profile RMS; averaging-window envelopes

acceptance_gate_sign_note: A1 is evaluated on the crest-bulk-corrected runs against the MGLET primary reference. The corrected WALE baseline no longer exceeds the DNS RMS, so the coupled 'wall-traction failure' verdict of 2026-08-22 is withdrawn independently of M4; what M4 certifies is that WHATEVER the corrected verdict is, it is the same under every subgrid-scale closure tested

bootstrap_protocol.note: identical to the WALE Level-3 primary protocol; WALE references resampled in the same draws

bulk_velocity_convention: crest-section u_b = 1 (meanVelocityForce Ubar = 2.036 Lz Lx / V_mesh = 0.721045); the 2026-08-22 deposits drove the volume average and are superseded
conclusion: INCOMPLETE or NOT INVARIANT - see missing_cases / table[*].criterion.
